author: (Doty) Doty ex P.C.Silva, 1996

note.en: A large red seaweed native to the Indo-Pacific and farmed worldwide for carrageenan; one herbarium specimen from Punta Puerto Vargas in Cahuita National Park[^3] is the only local record, and I found no evidence that it is established here. CHECK how that specimen got there.
note.es: Un alga roja grande nativa del Indo-Pacífico y cultivada en todo el mundo por su carragenina; un espécimen de herbario de Punta Puerto Vargas, en el Parque Nacional Cahuita[^3], es el único registro local, y no encontré evidencia de que esté establecida aquí. VERIFICAR cómo llegó ese espécimen.

evidence: GBIF: 1 herbarium specimen record in the region (Punta Puerto Vargas, Cahuita National Park, 2012)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón

recWhy: Herbarium specimen at Punta Puerto Vargas, Cahuita NP, 2012.
